Subcommittee on Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs Legislative Hearing

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email
Wednesday, July 10, 2024 | 10:15 AM 360 Cannon House Office Building
Tags: Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs

On Wednesday, July 10, 2024 at 10:15 am EST, the Subcommittee on Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs will hold a legislative hearing on "H.R. 2971, Veterans Claims Education Act of 2023; H.R. 6362, Protecting Benefits for Disabled Veterans Act of 2023; H.R. 6507, Mark Our Place Act; H.R. 7729, Dennis and Lois Krisfalusy Act; H.R. 8792, Flowers for Fallen Heroes Act of 2024; H.R. 8854, Ensuring Veterans’ Final Resting Place Act of 2024; H.R.
